about: Guelph/Eramosa is a township in Wellington County, Ontario, wrapping rural land, Rockwood, and hamlets around the separate City of Guelph—not the city itself. Limestone cliffs at Rockwood, farms, and the Eramosa River define a countryside municipality on Guelph’s edge. About 14,000 people live in Guelph/Eramosa Township.
